zh.title: 新加坡據報探討加入英義日主導之 GCAP 第六代戰機計畫
zh.summary: 新加坡據報正就參與全球空戰計畫進行初期探索性討論，但尚未做出任何承諾決定。該計畫由英國、義大利與日本主導，旨在開發具備出口潛力的下一代多用途戰機。
body: 根據航空新聞網站 Aerospace Global News 援引國防媒體 Janes 報導，新加坡正就加入全球空戰計畫 (Global Combat Air Programme, GCAP) 進行初期討論。報導引述一位不具名的知情人士消息，並強調目前的討論僅處於探索階段，新加坡方面尚未做出任何參與承諾。
該報導指出，這是新加坡正在正式評估與該計畫潛在關聯的首個已知跡象，此舉符合該國長期以來在大規模國防採購案前，習慣投入多年時間評估技術、產業機會與長期戰略的做法。
GCAP 計畫由英國、日本與義大利主導，目標是打造一架多用途第六代空優戰機，並著重於出口市場。負責開發的 BAE 正在組裝首架展示機，預計將在 2027 年首飛。

en.title: Singapore Reportedly in Early Talks on Joining UK, Japan-Led GCAP Sixth-Gen Fighter Programme
en.summary: Singapore is reportedly in exploratory discussions about possible involvement in the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP), with no commitment yet made, according to a Janes report. The programme, led by the UK, Japan and Italy, is developing an export-oriented next-generation fighter.
body: Singapore is holding early-stage discussions on potential involvement in the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP), also known as the Tempest programme, Aerospace Global News reported, citing a Janes article.

The talks are at an exploratory stage and no decisions have been made for Singapore to commit, the report stated, quoting an unnamed source close to the matter. Janes noted this is the first known indication Singapore is formally examining potential links to the programme.

The GCAP programme, led by Britain, Japan and Italy, is developing a multirole sixth-generation air superiority fighter optimized for export. The first demonstrator is currently being assembled by BAE Systems, with its first flight expected in 2027.
